title: Christine Winther Bang
text:
I’m a postdoc at the Department of Mathematical Sciences at the University of Copenhagen, where I’m working in the Copenhagen Causality Lab.
Previously, I was a PhD student in the Statistical Methods for Causal Inference group at the Leibniz Institute for Prevention Research and Epidemiology - BIPS in Bremen.
My research interests include graphical models and causal inference, and my current work is focused on causal discovery.
My email address is cwb (at) math (dot) ku (dot) dk.

title: Research
text:
Selected publications
Christine W Bang, Janine Witte, Ronja Foraita, and Vanessa Didelez. “Improving Finite Sample Performance of Causal Discovery by Exploiting Temporal Structure”. Statistical Methods in Medical Research (forthcoming), 2026 (link).

Christine W Bang and Vanessa Didelez. “Do we become wiser with time? On causal equivalence with tiered background knowledge”. Proceedings of the Thirty-Ninth Conference on Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence, PMLR 216:119-129, 2023 (link).
